description: Utility functions and constants for handling multi-value fields and tooltip templates in Deck.gl charts within the Superset project.

methods.name: isAggregatedDeckGLChart
methods.description: Checks if a given visualization type is an aggregated Deck.gl chart.

methods.name: fieldHasMultipleValues
methods.description: Determines if a tooltip item has multiple values based on chart type and item properties.

methods.name: createDefaultTemplateWithLimits
methods.description: Generates a tooltip template string with limits for multi-value fields.
